name: Focus Target Camera
move: camera pans and zooms between explicit UI targets while focus blur peaks during travel and resolves on arrival
how: Three UI cards live in an oversized world. The camera uses two expoInOut legs: overview to Insight, then Insight to Action. Blur is tied to travel velocity so destinations lock sharp.
adapt: Change card coordinates and camera targets; retain destination holds.
port: Use Motion.camera on a scoped world and interpolate target x/y/zoom.
